pipeline.resampling: scipy.resample_poly, default Kaiser window; context+epoch buffer only
pipeline.filter_initialization: zero-state per 40-second context+epoch buffer; discard first 10 seconds
pipeline.reference: selected montage average after temporal filtering
pipeline.normalization: divide referenced uV by 100; no subject/night fitted statistics

qc.scope: selected electrodes only, before average reference

pipeline.scope: Manual W/N1/N2/N3/R labels; R and REM map to REM; L excluded.
pipeline.deployment: research_only; real-device reference and domain validation pending
